verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a cloud platform like Runpod, but the evidence describes only a fully managed, hosted GPU cloud with Pods, Serverless and Clusters. The open-source CLI is a client tool, not the core product, and Community Cloud lets providers supply compute to Runpod rather than letting users run Runpod themselves. Neither is self-hosting of the core product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
